items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: "I wasn't about be playing with him"

ctx.x: So I said to myself, "I'm not gonna get in no argument with this cat. I told Slam, I said, "When we go back on, we're not going on the bandstand." I said, "Just bring the bass and follow me." I went to the bar, and Slam played at the bar, and then we played to the tables until the set was over. We did that the next set, and he got the message then. I wasn't about be playing with him (?), you know. And the next night, Panama was there; Zutty didn't show no more.
Well, I had no choice, man! And I liked Zutty, you know. But he just...
